hardRules: Joey manually runs Higgsfield Unlimited generation; do not spend connector generation credits automatically.
Quality and direct page usability outrank raw generation quantity.
No final 4K or expensive motion pass before a lower-cost still/reference winner exists.
A local Review winner checkbox is QA state only; it never publishes an asset.
A page replaces a coded placeholder only when the intended Selected Assets slot is selected and points to a real committed file.
Missing/pending/failed selected media fails safely back to coded presentation.
Agency v1.5 must feel like multiple bespoke worlds, not an AI gallery or one template recolored three times.
Plumbing remains showcase 01 and its worker identity must stay consistent where a recurring technician is used.
Generated demo visuals never masquerade as real client work, reviews, certifications, staff claims or measured outcomes.
Public pricing remains a test hypothesis until first-client evidence supports it.
Booking/contact CTA must never block a visitor from continuing to the cinematic ending.
